description.value: Blenz Coffee is a BC-based coffee chain with a downtown Victoria location at 1001 Douglas Street, a block from the Inner Harbour. The cafe offers espresso drinks, specialty lattes, whole-leaf teas, and a food menu spanning pastries, sandwiches, wraps, and more. Cyclists moving through the city core will find it a convenient stop for hot or cold drinks and a quick meal.
